title: A page item's mockup focus and fields are checked when it is written, not only when the page draws it
why: Incident (shiv, Nov 1 17:06 CST, photo of another repo's waiting page, item 51, speaker sheet volume fill, lane local_3808a094): the card showed "The picture of option A shows nothing the focus names" and "This item carries a field the page does not draw" to the owner. The page caught both, but only at render, on his screen.
note: Lane session_013NEJKykVMbU6Wws1sGPnAn, started Nov 1 17:08 CST (coordinator). Cause (read): hooks/question_form.py checks fields against main's itemFields list (rule item-field-rendered) but never checks a design's focus or state against its mockup, because the mockup lives in the page's designData, not the database. The skill's read-back (waiting-page, Add an item, step 2) asks the writer to check focus by hand; that step was skipped. A field warning means the item was written before the field guard, or the live page is older than main's list (stale_pages would say behind). Not the advisor: the advisor answers no question and checks no page write. Fix in one home: the design republish (Add a design, step 3) runs the page's own focus and state test on <out> before publish, and refuses a design whose focus or state finds nothing; same test code as the page, never a copy. Item 51 is most likely on home's page (assumed: its card cites a SPEC.md banner line and Duo step duo-fold-3; home keeps SPEC.md and the folded-Duo work, per step c169); its writer fixes it. Red first on a mockup with a missing focus. Cloud lane, claude-settings only. Needs no answer. Placed after local-cc-version-lag (triage 5). Second incident (shiv, Nov 1 17:09 CST, photo of home's item 43, keep sheets on the right page): each option's picture is a thin strip too short to read, on the card and in the viewer, because each mockup lays several screens side by side and the page scales it to the width. Same fix home: the pre-publish test also refuses a picture whose scaled height on the card is below a readable floor (number set by the lane, from the page's fit code, and recorded with its source). Both items go to home's writer as page task 142.
